traitdesc-ft_bite: You can bite with your bare jaws. Press B while unarmed to bite a nearby creature for 1 point of piercing damage. Required by the Venomous Bites and Psychedelic Bites traits.
charattribute-ft_bite-1: Unarmed bite: press B while unarmed to bite a nearby creature (required by the venomous and psychedelic bite traits)
traitdesc-ft_venomousbites: Your body can hold poison in place of food. Poisonous meals still feed you, but 30% of their satiety is stored as poison until your real hunger runs out. Maximum hunger +40%. Unarmed bites transfer stored poison to your target. Requires the Unarmed Bite trait. Includes 15% poison resistance.
traitdesc-ft_psychedelicbites: Your body can hold psychedelics in place of food. Psychedelic meals still feed you, but 30% of their satiety is stored as psychedelics until your real hunger runs out. Maximum hunger +40%. Unarmed bites transfer stored psychedelics to your target. Requires the Unarmed Bite trait. Includes 15% psychedelic resistance.
charattribute-ft_poisonstorage-1: Poison storage: poisonous food satiates you, storing 30% of its satiety as poison (maximum hunger +40%)
charattribute-ft_venomousbite-1: Venomous bite: unarmed bites transfer stored poison to the target (requires unarmed bite capability)
charattribute-ft_poisonresistance-0.15: Poison resistance: reduces poison effects by 15%
charattribute-ft_psychedelicstorage-1: Psychedelic storage: psychedelic food satiates you, storing 30% of its satiety as psychedelics (maximum hunger +40%)
charattribute-ft_psychedelicbite-1: Psychedelic bite: unarmed bites transfer stored psychedelics to the target (requires unarmed bite capability)
charattribute-ft_psychedelicresistance-0: Psychedelic resistance: reduces psychedelic effects by 15%
